name: SGLang grammar-constrained waiting-queue gauge
notes: SGLang main, python/sglang/srt/observability/metrics_collector.py, read 2026-10-04. NOT ON BY DEFAULT: nothing is exported unless --enable-metrics (ServerArgs default False), which is also the only thing that mounts /metrics on the server port. Label keys are model_name, engine_type, tp_rank, pp_rank, moe_ep_rank (plus dp_rank under data parallelism, priority under priority scheduling, and anything in extra_metric_labels). Bucket ladders are overridable per histogram via get_histogram_conf_from_env. A second waiting queue: requests held for structured-output grammar compilation rather than for capacity. The closest thing this fleet has to vLLM's waiting-by-reason split, though it covers only the grammar reason.
